column1: # CAPTION: Data are mean (95% CI). Source: ADEFF (primary)
column2: ADVS/ADLB at Week 48 (secondary/exploratory). Primary endpoint: percent change from baseline computed as (AVAL) from ADEFF using the efficacy estimand (on-treatment data with hypothetical strategy for discontinuation). Secondary endpoints: CHG = AVAL - BASE from ADVS/ADLB at AVISITN=48 with ANL01FL='Y'. Lipids and hsCRP show PCHG (percent change). 95% CI = mean +/- 1.96*SE where SE = SD/sqrt(n).
